units.source_text: 内大臣严守秘密，暂时勿使外人闻知此事。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior guarded the secret strictly and, for the time being, did not let outsiders hear of it.

units.source_text: 但搬嘴弄舌，乃世人常习，此事自然泄露于外，渐渐传遍世间，那位口没遮拦的近江君也听到了。

en.t: But gossip is the common habit of the world, and the matter naturally leaked out; little by little it spread everywhere, until the unguarded Omi no Kimi heard of it too.

units.source_text: 她来到弘徽殿女御面前，正值柏木中将和弁少将在座。

en.t: She came before the Kokiden Consort, just when Lieutenant General Kashiwagi and Lesser Captain Ben were present.

units.source_text: 她毫无顾虑地言道：“父亲又找到了一个女儿呢。

en.t: Without the least hesitation she said, "Father has found another daughter, it seems.

units.source_text: 啊呀，此人真好福气啊！

en.t: My, what good fortune that person has!

units.source_text: 不知到底是怎样的一个人，所以两位大臣都如此看重。

en.t: I wonder what sort of person she can be, for both ministers to value her so highly.

units.source_text: 听说她的母亲出身也很微贱呢。”

en.t: I hear that her mother came from a very low background too."

units.source_text: 女御听了很难过，一声不响。

en.t: The Consort was deeply pained to hear this and said nothing.

units.source_text: 柏木中将对她说道：“两位大臣都看重她，总是有缘故的。

en.t: Lieutenant General Kashiwagi said to her, "If both ministers value her, there must be a reason.

units.source_text: 我倒要问：你从哪里听到这些话，这样突如其来地说出来？

en.t: What I would like to ask is where you heard such talk, and why you suddenly blurted it out like this.

units.source_text: 谨防被快嘴快舌的侍女们听见啊！”

en.t: Be careful that the quick-tongued ladies-in-waiting do not overhear you!"

units.source_text: 近江君恨恨地答道：“哎呀，你不要多嘴！

en.t: Omi no Kimi answered resentfully, "Oh, do not meddle!

units.source_text: 我全都知道了。

en.t: I know everything now.

units.source_text: 她要入宫去当尚侍呢。

en.t: She is going to enter palace service and become Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 我早就来此供职，正为了想蒙照顾，推荐我入宫去当尚侍。

en.t: I came here to serve long ago precisely because I hoped to be favored and recommended to enter the palace as Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 所以连普通侍女们所不屑做的事，我也都起劲地去做。

en.t: That is why I eagerly do even the tasks ordinary ladies-in-waiting disdain.

units.source_text: 女御不推荐我，太无情了！”

en.t: For the Consort not to recommend me is far too heartless!"

units.source_text: 说得大家都笑起来。

en.t: At that, everyone burst out laughing.

units.source_text: 柏木便揶揄她：“尚侍倘有缺额，我等都希望去当呢。

en.t: Kashiwagi teased her, "If there were an opening for Naishi no Kami, even we would want the post.

units.source_text: 你也来抢，太不客气了。”

en.t: For you to come and compete for it too is rather forward."

units.source_text: 近江君生气了，答道：“像我这种微不足道的人，本不该参加在你们这些贵公子中。

en.t: Omi no Kimi grew angry and replied, "A person as insignificant as I am should never have joined the company of noble gentlemen like you.

units.source_text: 都是中将不好，多事地接我进来，教我在这里给人嘲笑。

en.t: It is all the Lieutenant General's fault for officiously bringing me in and making me a laughingstock here.

units.source_text: 原来这里是寻常人不能进来的王府！

en.t: So this is a royal mansion where ordinary people may not enter!

units.source_text: 可怕可怕！”

en.t: How frightening, how frightening!"

units.source_text: 说着退向后面，眼睛注视这边。

en.t: Saying this, she withdrew toward the back while keeping her eyes fixed in their direction.

units.source_text: 样子并不可恶，然而怒气冲冲，两眼倒竖。

en.t: Her appearance was not hateful, but she was furious, her eyes glaring upward.

units.source_text: 柏木中将听了她这话，觉得确是自己错误，只得板起面孔，一言不答。

en.t: When Lieutenant General Kashiwagi heard her words, he felt that the fault was indeed his, so he could only put on a stern face and say nothing.

units.source_text: 弁少将赔着笑脸对她说道：“你在此供职，忠诚无比，女御决不忽视。

en.t: Lesser Captain Ben smiled conciliatingly and said to her, "You serve here with incomparable devotion, and the Consort will certainly not overlook it.

units.source_text: 请你放心吧。

en.t: Please set your mind at ease.

units.source_text: 看你那模样，即使坚硬的岩石，也能一脚踢成雪粉。

en.t: Looking at you now, one would think you could kick even solid rock into powdery snow.

units.source_text: 可知不久自有如意称心的一天。”

en.t: Surely a day will soon come when everything goes just as you wish."

units.source_text: 柏木中将接着说：“照你这样子，不如笼闭在天上的岩门里，倒可平安无事。”

en.t: Lieutenant General Kashiwagi added, "In that state, you would be better off shut up inside the heavenly rock cave; then all might be peaceful."

units.source_text: 说过便走了。

en.t: Having said this, he went away.

units.source_text: 近江君咿咿呀呀地哭起来，叫道：“连这些人都看我不起了！

en.t: Omi no Kimi began sobbing noisily and cried, "Even these people look down on me now!

units.source_text: 只有女御真心爱我，所以我在这里当差。”

en.t: Only the Consort truly cares for me, and that is why I serve here."

units.source_text: 她就兴高采烈地做事。

en.t: Then she set about her work in high spirits.

units.source_text: 下等侍女及女童等所吃不消的杂役，她都不惮烦劳，东奔西走地去做，全心全意地为女御服务。

en.t: She did not shrink from troublesome errands that even lower-ranking maids and young girls found unbearable, but ran here and there doing them, serving the Consort with all her heart.

units.source_text: 常常向她恳愿：“请你推荐我去当尚侍！”

en.t: She often pleaded with her, "Please recommend me to become Naishi no Kami!"

units.source_text: 女御不胜厌烦，想道：“这个人竟说出这种话来，不知她心里是怎样想的。”

en.t: The Consort found it unbearably tiresome and thought, "For this person to say such things, what can she possibly be thinking?"

units.source_text: 只得对她闭口无言。

en.t: She could only remain silent toward her.
